an4.159:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an4.159:1.3: athakho aññatarā bhikkhunī aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi
an4.159:1.4: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa yena ayyo ānando tenupasaṅkama upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena ayyassa ānandassa pāde sirasā vanda
an4.159:1.5: itthannāmā bhante bhikkhunī ābādhikinī dukkhitā bāḷhagilānā
an4.159:1.6: sā ayyassa ānandassa pāde sirasā vandatīti evañca vadehi
an4.159:1.7: sādhu kira bhante ayyo ānando yena bhikkhunūpassayo yena sā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
an4.159:1.8: evaṃ ayyeti kho so puriso tassā bhikkhuniyā paṭissuṇitvā yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
an4.159:2.1: itthannāma bhante bhikkhunī ābādhikinī dukkhitā bāḷhagilānā
an4.159:2.2: sā ayyassa ānandassa pāde sirasā vandati evañca vadeti
an4.159:2.3: sādhu kira bhante ayyo ānando yena bhikkhunūpassayo yena sā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
an4.159:3.1: athakho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena bhikkhunūpassayo tenupasaṅkami.
an4.159:3.2: addasā kho sā bhikkhunī āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
an4.159:3.4: athakho āyasmā ānando yena sā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho āyasmā ānando taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca
an4.159:4.1: āhārasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo āhāraṃ nissāya
an4.159:4.3: taṇhāsambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo taṇhaṃ nissāya
an4.159:4.5: mānasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo mānaṃ nissāya
an4.159:4.8: methuno pahātabbo methuno setughāto vutto bhagavatā.
an4.159:5.1: āhārasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo āhāraṃ nissāya
an4.159:5.2: āhāro pahātabboti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ
an4.159:5.4: idha bhagini bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti
an4.159:5.5: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsuparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti
an4.159:5.6: so aparena samayena āhāraṃ nissāya āhāraṃ pajahati
an4.159:5.7: āhārasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo āhāraṃ nissāya āhāro pahātabboti
an4.159:5.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an4.159:6.1: taṇhāsambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo taṇhaṃ nissāya
an4.159:6.2: taṇhā pahātabbāti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ
an4.159:6.5: itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti
an4.159:6.7: kadāssu nāma ahaṃpi āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissāmīti
an4.159:6.8: so aparena samayena taṇhaṃ nissāya taṇhaṃ pajahati
an4.159:6.9: taṇhāsambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo taṇhaṃ nissāya taṇhā pahātabbāti
an4.159:6.10: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an4.159:7.1: mānasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo mānaṃ nissāya
an4.159:7.2: māno pahātabboti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ
an4.159:7.5: itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti
an4.159:7.7: so hi nāma āyasmā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati
an4.159:7.9: so aparena samayena mānaṃ nissāya mānaṃ pajahati
an4.159:7.10: mānasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo mānaṃ nissāya māno pahātabboti
an4.159:7.11: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an4.159:8.2: methuno pahātabbo methuno setughāto vutto bhagavatāti.
an4.159:9.1: athakho sā bhikkhunī mañcakā vuṭṭhahitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṃgaṃ karitvā āyasmato ānandassa pādesu sirasā nipatitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
an4.159:9.2: accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yāhaṃ evamakāsiṃ
an4.159:9.3: tassā me bhante ayyo ānando accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyāti.
an4.159:9.4: taggha taṃ bhagini accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yā tvaṃ evamakāsi
an4.159:9.5: yato ca kho tvaṃ bhagini accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi tante mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma
an4.159:9.6: vuḍḍhihesā bhagini ariyassa vinaye yā accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti.
